To record receipt of annual cash interest ($55,000 x 9%)

notes: Purchased for par, so there is no premium/discount and amortized cost is $55,000 at every measurement date; interest revenue equals the $4,950 annual cash coupon. FVA schedule signs: positive = debit FVA (cumulative holding gain), negative = credit FVA (cumulative holding loss). Sale-date fair value is taken as the $57,750 proceeds. Realized gain reclassified out of AOCI equals proceeds minus amortized cost, leaving ending Year 3 AOCI of zero.
